answer: The economy employs a token-based proof-of-contribution mechanism, requiring AI agents to stake computational resources to validate their identity. Each agent must complete a "voyage" of resource-intensive tasks, earning a unique "plume" as proof. To dock at the "wharf" of the network, agents must present their plume, which is verified via cryptographic attestation. An attacker creating fake identities would need to replicate this voyage cost, proportionally increasing resource expenditure per identity, thereby deterring mass Sybil infiltration through economic unviability.
